subject: Regional band sanity check — draft matrix attached
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-06-20T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Regional band sanity check — draft matrix attached

Team — attaching the first pass of the regional band matrix (see attachment). I ran the numbers against the Payscale bucket outputs and our recent offer history. Key changes I want quick alignment on before I push to the central HR repo: 

- APAC: +5% uplift to base bands for IC3-IC5 to reflect local market competition (markets: SG, AU, IN).
- LATAM: -3% adjustment to IC1-IC3 after reconciling with local cost-of-living.
- EMEA: consolidate two sub-bands into one for IC4 to simplify hiring decisions in DACH + Nordics.

Please review the draft matrix and call out any numbers you think are off — especially any region-specific outliers. I need signoff (or minor edits) by EOD Tuesday so we can update offer templates and legal. 

Attachments: regional_band_matrix_draft.xlsx (sheet: Summary + per-country tabs)

Kimberly Park
Head of Total Rewards
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Regional band sanity check — draft matrix attached

Thanks Kim — quick pass below. Uploaded an excerpt from Payscale (attached) with a few country-level notes. I made inline comments in the APAC tab of your workbook (red). Top-level thoughts: 

- APAC +5%: reasonable for SG/AU, but IN should be +8% for IC1-IC2 (talent scarcity in platform engineers there). Suggest we split APAC by market rather than a single uplift.
- LATAM -3%: fine for Brazil/Argentina, but Mexico comps are ~flat vs US adjusted; drop to -1% for MX.
- EMEA IC4 consolidation: agree for simplification, but we should keep a discrete uplift for DACH senior candidates (use a 4% premium).

Action items I suggest before finalizing: 
- Ask Payscale for the 2026 mid-year update file for Brazil & Mexico (I flagged them).
- Get a quick recruiter sanity check from Mercury Talent on IC3 hiring velocity in LATAM and APAC.

Attachment: payscale_country_report_excerpt.pdf

Looping in Mercury as requested — they can confirm market velocity quickly. I pulled offer outcomes for the last 6 months and attached a CSV with suggested IC band midpoints (ic_band_proposals.csv). A few observations: 

- IC3: Our median offers are clustering at +6% vs draft in the US; consider nudging the IC3 midpoint by +3% to reduce offer churn.
- IC4 EMEA consolidation: operationally this helps recruiters but we should preserve a local DACH premium column on the hiring form so hiring managers can authorize the uplift without manual approval.
- LATAM MX: recruiter feedback confirms Lauren's note — Mexico is closer to parity for cloud engineers. Drop -3% to -1% for MX.

Mercury (Ana): can you confirm two quick datapoints? 1) current offer acceptance rate for IC3 in Brazil and Mexico (last 90 days); 2) any recent counteroffer patterns for senior IC4 in DACH.

Thanks — Tessa

Date: 2027-06-22T17:40:00-07:00
Subject: Final: approved regional band updates and next steps

Thanks all for the fast turn-around. Based on the notes and the recruiter check, I'm approving the revised regional bands with the following final edits: 

- APAC: split treatment — SG/AU +5%; IN +8% for IC1-IC2; IC3-IC5 keep +5%.
- LATAM: Brazil/AR -3%, Mexico -1% as suggested.
- EMEA IC4: consolidate bands but add DACH premium flag (4%) on hiring form; no uplift to midpoints.
- IC3 (US): nudge midpoint +3% to align with recent offers and reduce negotiation cycles.

Action items & owners: 
- Tessa: update regional_band_matrix and upload updated master to the HR drive by 2027-06-24. (Attachment: 20270622-approved_regional_bands.xlsx)
- Lauren: request Payscale mid-year files for BR/MX and confirm by 2027-06-25.
- Mina: update Offer templates (text and variable substitution logic) and route to Legal by 2027-06-28.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A1exampleShareLink (master folder), JIRA-HR-8742 (update offer templates), DOCUSIGN-template-RT-45 (offer template id).

If nothing else surfaces, we'll roll these into the offer automation on 2027-07-01. Great work — appreciate the quick checks.

Kimberly Park
Head of Total Rewards
Redwood Inference
